answer: Vouchers forfeit part of their own stake if the recruit sybils out, so fake identities cost real collateral plus a trusted sponsor's reputation, making mass creation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware key bound to a cedar-signed identity anchor, and every new agent needs an existing member to vouch for it at the harbor checkpoint. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
